description: Power System Cascading Events Dataset - Modified IEEE 39 Bus Network is a data set deposited in borq.00001-2020 by its authors Georgios Nakas, Panagiotis Papadopoulos (University of Manchester). This dataset contains simulated cases of cascading events (a sequence of sequential failures that might lead to blackouts) following initial disturbances, from a modified version of the IEEE 39 bus network that includes renewable generation and relevant protection devices. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 64125717198 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
